Grandma's Banana Bread

This banana bread recipe has been in my family for three generations and it is the one I make every single time we have brown bananas sitting on the counter. It's moist, simple, and works every time.

Ingredients

  • 3 ripe bananas
  • 1/3 cup melted butter
  • 3/4 cup sugar
  • 1 egg, beaten
  • 1 tsp vanilla
  • 1 tsp baking soda
  • 1 1/2 cups flour

Instructions

  1. Preheat oven to 350°F.
  2. Mash bananas and mix in butter.
  3. Stir in the rest, pour into a loaf pan, bake 60 minutes.
